name: Habit Streaks
summary: Track daily habits with a tap and watch your streaks grow over the week.
author: Maya R.
prompts: Make a habit tracker where I can add habits and tick them off each day.
Show the last 7 days for each habit as a row of dots and show the current streak.
Let me delete a habit by pressing a small remove button, and ask before deleting.

name: Split It
summary: Work out the tip and what each person owes, with quick percentage buttons.
author: Jonas K.
prompts: A tip calculator: I type the bill, pick a tip percentage and the number of people, and it shows the total and the amount per person.
Remember my last tip percentage and number of people.

name: Pocket Notes
summary: A fast, private notepad. Notes save as you type and never leave your phone.
author: Priya S.

name: Focus Timer
summary: 25-minute focus sessions with short breaks and a count of sessions finished today.
author: Tomás A.
prompts: Build a pomodoro timer with a big circular countdown: 25 minutes of focus, then a 5 minute break.
Count how many focus sessions I finished today and reset the count each day.

name: Spend Log
summary: Log what you spend by category and see this month's total at a glance.
author: Lena W.
